definitions.full: H4257. Machalath מַחֲלַת noun feminine only in Psalm titles ׳עַלמֿ Psa 53:1 ; 88:1 ; apparently a catchword in a song, giving name to tune; meaning dubious; Aq Symm. מְחֹלֹת ᵑ9 dance ; see Ol Psalmen, p. 27 Bae Psalmen, p. xviii . III. חלה ( adorn ; compare Arabic adorn , (neck-) ornament ).
